cancellation_result.details: cancel_mission() works from RECEIVED, EXECUTING, HUMAN_REQUIRED states. Idempotent. Events: MISSION_CANCEL_REQUESTED, MISSION_CANCELLED, MISSION_STATE_CHANGED. Resources released via complete_mission().

pause_resume_result.details: pause_mission() sets pause flag, actual pause at checkpoint in execute_task_graph(). resume_mission() clears flag and transitions PAUSED->EXECUTING. Events: MISSION_PAUSE_REQUESTED, MISSION_PAUSED, MISSION_RESUME_REQUESTED, MISSION_RESUMED, MISSION_STATE_CHANGED.

human_gate_result.details: create_human_gate() transitions EXECUTING->HUMAN_REQUIRED, stores gate with options/context. decide_human_gate() handles 'continue' (->EXECUTING) and 'cancel' (->CANCELLED). Events: HUMAN_GATE_CREATED, HUMAN_DECISION_RECORDED, MISSION_STATE_CHANGED.

durable_resume_result.details: Checkpoint save/load/restore implemented in Engine. Cross-runtime resume verified in E7/E8 (test_e7_cross_runtime_resume_no_rerun_completed). Artifacts/evidence persist via FileEvidenceStore. Resource quotas reallocated on new engine.

concurrency_result.details: Multiple cancel/pause/resume calls safe. No duplicate events. No resource leaks. State machine prevents invalid concurrent transitions.

resource_accounting_result.details: complete_mission() releases quotas idempotently. cancel_mission() calls complete_mission(). No negative counters. max(0, counter-1) pattern maintained.

event_trace_result.details: All 8 new control event types emitted with complete payloads. Event ordering verified. No duplicate events on idempotent operations. Cross-engine isolation maintained.

regression.details: All 91 tests pass (43 unified + 48 contracts). No regressions introduced.

open_gaps.impact: Accumulates indefinitely across runs in single engine instance
Pause flag set but checkpoint creation depends on checkpoint_every parameter
open_gaps.decision: Future enhancement - auto-checkpoint on pause request

open_gaps.impact: Mission/task state not auto-persisted; requires explicit checkpoint

e11_verdict.e11_blockers: None - All AC met. Core control plane (cancel, pause/resume, human gate) mechanically verified. Durable resume infrastructure exists and tested in E7/E8. Resource safety maintained. Event trace complete.
